outline.chapter_title: Introduction to Attention and Hardware Bottlenecks
outline.description: This chapter provides the necessary mathematical and hardware foundation to understand why attention is a bottleneck and how GPU architectures influence the design of efficient kernels.
subtopics: The Mathematics of Multi-Head Attention (MHA)
Computational Complexity and Quadratic Scaling
The GPU Memory Hierarchy: Global Memory (HBM), L2 Cache, Shared Memory (SMEM), and Registers (RMEM)
The Concept of Memory-Bound vs. Compute-Bound Operations
The Impact of Sequence Length on LLM Performance

outline.description: Before diving into FlashAttention-3, this chapter explains the evolution of the FlashAttention series and the core concepts of tiling and online softmax.
subtopics: The Problem with Standard Attention: Materialization of Large Intermediate Matrices
FlashAttention-1: Tiling and the Online Softmax Algorithm
FlashAttention-2: Parallelization over Sequence Length and Work Distribution
The Role of Recomputation in the Backward Pass
Evaluation of Hardware Utilization on NVIDIA Ampere vs. Hopper Architectures

outline.description: This chapter explores the hardware-specific features of the NVIDIA Hopper architecture and how FlashAttention-3 uses them to overlap data movement with computation.
subtopics: Hopper GPU Architecture: Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA) and WGMMA
Warp-Specialization: Producer and Consumer Roles
Software Pipelining with Circular SMEM Buffers
Asynchronous Memory Copy and Instruction Issue Latency
Register Reallocation using setmaxnreg

outline.chapter_title: Advanced Pipelining: Overlapping GEMM and Softmax
outline.description: This chapter focuses on the algorithmic techniques used to hide the latency of non-matmul operations, such as the exponential functions in softmax.
subtopics: The Throughput Gap: Matmul TFLOPs vs. Special Function TFLOPs
Pingpong Scheduling: Inter-warpgroup Overlapping
Intra-warpgroup Overlapping: The 2-Stage GEMM-Softmax Pipeline
Breaking Sequential Dependencies through Register Buffering
Practical Constraints: Compiler Reordering and Register Pressure

outline.description: This chapter details the transition to FP8 precision, covering both the hardware layout challenges and the numerical strategies to maintain accuracy.
subtopics: FP8 (e4m3) Number Format and Throughput Advantages
Layout Conformance: MN-major vs. K-major Constraints
Implementing In-kernel Transpose using LDSM and STSM
Handling Accumulator Layouts: Byte Permutation and Register Movement
Mitigating Quantization Error: Block Quantization
Incoherent Processing: Using Random Orthogonal and Hadamard Matrices

outline.description: The final chapter analyzes the results of FlashAttention-3, comparing it against baselines and discussing the trade-offs between speed and numerical precision.
subtopics: Benchmarking Metrics: TFLOPs and Execution Time
Forward and Backward Pass Performance Analysis
Comparison with cuDNN and Triton Implementations
Numerical Stability: Measuring RMSE and Outlier Impact
Conclusion: The Future of Long-Context Transformers
